set.body:
Work key: L01.1
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Set an engineering target on the product owner’s computer without assuming institutional approval.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record the local runtime, loopback/security/storage boundaries, synthetic fixture budget and guarded lifecycle/reset requirements without provisioning a persistent service implicitly.
2. Select approved native-BIDS staging as the engineering intake baseline and specify the two-lab/guest guided repository story and exact observable outcomes.
3. Identify existing implementation dependencies and later institutional gates; local data/provider choices cannot masquerade as institutional acceptance or block independent engineering.

Verification: Reviewed local engineering contract and a dependency-graph check proving the demo has no institutional or mixed-input blockers.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md

Blocked by:
- F01: bd-01M4W40J9S9Z7GFMS5DR2SZEV5

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: L01.1: Specify the local installation and demonstration contract
